cases.customer_question: Can a qualification proceed when the review page shows an ICS warning related to a waived test case?
question_variants: Can registration proceed with a TCW?
Why is a yellow warning shown in the ICS form?
Does a TCW allow submission despite review warnings?
Will the qualification be accepted with a test case waiver?
cases.actual_issue: Understanding whether a qualification submission remains valid when an ICS-related warning is present because a Test Case Waiver has been approved.
cases.plain_english_explanation: The customer noticed a warning indicator on the qualification review page and wanted to know whether submission could continue. The warning was linked to a waived test case rather than an unresolved qualification problem. The consultant clarified the difference.
cases.consultant_answer: The review page displayed a warning in the ICS section, but the relevant Test Case Waiver had already been applied and approved. Because the waiver covered the affected requirement, the qualification remained in a state that could be accepted and submitted. The customer was asked to review and approve the final registration contents before submission.
cases.decision_logic: A warning associated with an approved Test Case Waiver does not automatically invalidate a qualification submission. The determining factor is whether the waiver has been properly applied and accepted.
cases.final_recommendation: Verify that the Test Case Waiver is approved and properly linked to the submission, then proceed with final review and registration approval.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: The team may unnecessarily delay qualification completion or incorrectly assume that the submission contains a blocking error when it is already eligible for acceptance.
